title: AssignmentAttemptJourney
description: Assignment journey used in for SignOn. If a list of calls is provided, the journey will be assumed to be a DeadRun

vehicleJourneyId.description: Required if calls are not provided. Also known as 'turnummer'/trip number of the journey.

lineId.description: Required if calls are not provided. Id for the line, e.g.: 'RUT:Line:32'. RUT:Line:0 can be used for DeadRuns

departureDateTime.description: Planned departure date time for the first call in the journey. This field is used to pinpoint the exact dated journey to be serviced. DateTime as specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io)

serviceWindow.description: If the vehicle will not service the entire planned journey, the service window can be used to limit the calls included in the resulting assignment.

calls.description: The call structure will result in a DeadRun. Please provide a list of two or more calls.
